answer_1.quote: Chart summarization requires faithfully extracting quantitative data and describing them using natural language.

answer_2.quote: We report a wide range of metrics' scores across the three benchmarks.

answer_3.quote: we use CoT prompt and average over 8 samples

answer_4.quote: We randomly sampled 60 different charts from Chart-To-Text (Statista) test set and surveyed the Entailment, Relevance, and Grammaticality
answer_4.guideline: 1. is_interesting highlights an important insight from the chart such as min / max / avg value or comparison. 2. cleaned_summary_is_grammatically_correct = grammar and fluency. 3. Entailed = you do not need additional info: using the chart only, be able to extract the text. 4. Approximate numbers is allowed up to 2 digits after the decimal. 5. grammatically_correct = look at grammar errors / fluency / repetition.
